🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* US Government / Donald Trump
• *Announcement:* The US is poised to impose significant tariffs, including a 100\% tariff on branded and patented pharmaceutical imports effective October 1, 2025, aimed at shifting production to the US\. Further, the US Senate has authorized tariffs up to 100\% on countries, including India, for continued purchases of Russian oil\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH \(85\% \- The pharmaceutical tariff is a specific announced policy, and the Russian oil tariff bill has passed the US Senate, signaling strong legislative intent and advanced policy stages\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Pharma \(Generics, APIs\), OGCs \(due to Russian oil purchases\), Textiles, Metals/Auto \(Auto Components\), Chemicals \(Specialty\)
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Escalating US trade protectionism against key Indian exports and energy policies, coupled with existing tariffs and investigations, creates significant uncertainty and risk\-off sentiment for FIIs\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should actively de\-risk portfolios by reducing exposure to US\-dependent Pharma and other export\-oriented sectors vulnerable to escalating US tariffs\. Consider reallocating to domestic\-focused industries or those with diversified international trade partnerships\.
